acceptanceCriteria: dogfood change or dogfood check reports an agent pre-change receipt whose tree is not the change base, with a regression test; an absent receipt stays non-blocking unless an owner decision says otherwise.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from panel finding M1 (pre-1.0 review) as the part decision 0395 (DCW-V0-026, PR #222) leaves open. dogfood change no longer overwrites the agent pre-change receipts (<git-dir>/corvint/prechange-query.json and prechange-impact.json), but it does not read, bind or check which tree they came from, so a missing or stale receipt (written against a tree other than the change base) is no more visible than before. Add a check that records each agent receipt tree and reports a receipt whose tree is not the base tree. Keep an absent receipt non-blocking, as DOGFOOD-002 does not require one: report absent or stale receipts as visible NOT_PRODUCED or findings unless an owner decision makes them blocking.

Read-only independent verification (Codex batch C) plus mechanical check of cited commits, tests and paths; no suite rerun for this closure.
